{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|The Bantha is a gift from beyond whose meaning we have not yet begun to fathom! For when we do finally come to understand why the Bantha has been placed throughout the galaxy, we will achieve the Age of Bounty!|Hen|<ref name="TM">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref>}}
The '''Age of Bounty''' was a prophesied state that would be achieved when the mystery of why the [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] had been placed through [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] was understood. The [[Dim-U/Legends|Dim-U]] [[Priest/Legends|priest]]<ref name="TM" /> [[Hen]]<ref name="TM-CA3">{{WEGCite|story=Tatooine Manhunt|book=Classic Adventures: Volume Three}}</ref> in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] preached about the Age of Bounty.<ref name="TM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The "Age of Bounty" was mentioned in the sermon of a street preacher in Mos Eisley in ''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''. When the adventure was reprinted in ''[[Classic Adventures: Volume Three]]'', the mention of the Age of Bounty was removed from his speech.<ref name="TM" />
